example.title: Pawnee River tributary bridge, county road DD
example.place: 8.8 miles south of Kansas Highway 96, Ness County, KS
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Pawnee River tributary bridge, county road DD (Ness County, Kansas))

brief: Twin-barrel stone arch culvert on a county road: two semicircular arches separated by a central pier, the headwalls and long flared, stair-stepped wing walls built of buff limestone blocks in even courses with thick stepped coping. The parapets are low and the road edge is protected by W-beam guardrail with yellow-and-black hazard markers at each corner. Dead-flat treeless plains with a farmstead and power poles on the horizon.

traits.railing_detail: W-beam guardrail over low stone parapet
